messages:
dee-support: FYI - Customer AceroHealth escalated, started seeing widespread 401s around 09:02 UTC. Error in our gateway logs is `invalid_signature` and `kid not found`. They rotated keys yesterday but only some clients are failing. Repro attached.

maria-eng: Ugh. seeing similar alerts in our prod signature-error metric. spike ~09:00-09:10 UTC. Not many, but concentrated on a single region (us-west-2).

sam-oncall: @maria-eng can you paste a raw example of the failing JWT header + server log? Need to know if kid mismatch or sig verification actually failing after fetching JWKS.

dee-support: here is the sample header and server verify error from AceroHealth (sanitized):

```json
{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","kid":"key-rotated-2026"}
```

server log:

```
2026-03-09T09:03:12Z gateway verify_jwt ERROR: signature verification failed, kid key-rotated-2026 not present in cached JWKS (cache_ttl=86400s)
```

maria-eng: that cache_ttl=86400s (24h) is suspicious. Our JWKS cache is long for perf but if a key rotation happened and the jwks endpoint rotated KIDs frequently that's a mismatch window.

ken-infra: I can see a deploy-bot entry (jwks-rotation-service) at 08:58 UTC that pushed a new JWKS set and removed a legacy kid. If clients minted tokens against the old kid shortly before rotation, servers with stale cache could fail until they refresh.

nicole-platform: we intentionally cache JWKS for 24h in the edge runtime to avoid thundering-herd and N+ calls. But we have logic to fetch on verify-fail fallback, right? We should be refetching on `kid not found`.

maria-eng: looks like the fallback path is broken in the edge runtime path. Verified code: on verify error we only refetch on network errors, not on `kid not found`. So if the kid is missing we return 401 instead of re-fetching JWKS.

sam-oncall: omg. explains why only some regions saw failures (they hit an edge instance that had stale JWKS). Repro steps to validate locally:

1) start local edge runtime with JWKS cache TTL set high (24h)
2) fetch certs from test-jwks endpoint (v1) then rotate to v2 (remove kid X)
3) present token signed with kid X to edge -> should trigger `kid not found` and currently returns 401 without refetch.

I tested this repro and confirmed behavior.

dee-support: Customer workaround: they can reissue tokens (recommended) or we can ask them to briefly rotate back to include old kid while we patch. They prefer we fix, obviously.

ken-infra: mitigation we can do now: 1) purge JWKS cache on the problematic edge nodes (I'll roll a cache-flush command), 2) temporarily lower cache TTL to 5m via runtime flag for all edges to reduce blast window while we patch.

nicole-platform: agree. Also add a synthetic monitor that alerts if signature-error-rate > 0.5% over baseline per-region. Put it on-call.

maria-eng: patch plan:
- short term (hotfix): change fallback to re-fetch JWKS when verify returns `kid not found` and retry verification once. Add unit test for that. Owner: maria-eng. ETA: 2h for patch + 30m canary, then roll.
- mid term: add cache-control / `jwks_cache_ttl` per-customer or per-route override, and make cache invalidation API available to support. Owner: ken-infra + nicole-platform. ETA: 2d.
- long term: keyboard: implement JWKs delta fetch + push notify from rotation service. Owner: infra team. ETA: 3w.

sam-oncall: I can do hotfix rollout with canary to us-west-2 first. Will coordinate with ken for cache flush. Also open a P0 incident for visibility. INC-2026 created.

jwks-bot: automated-notice: jwks-rotation-service rotated keys for AceroHealth at 2026-03-09T08:58:17Z (removed kid: key-legacy-12, new kid: key-rotated-2026).

dee-support: Logged with customer and gave them the temp workaround (re-issue tokens or accept transient 401s until we patch). They're okay with quick fix. Keeping them updated.

maria-eng: small code snippet for fallback implementation (pseudo):

```python
try:
    verify(jwt, cached_jwks)
except KidNotFoundError:
    jwks = fetch_jwks(force_refresh=True)
    verify(jwt, jwks)
```

maria-eng: also adding a metric `jwks.refetch_on_kid_not_found` and an alert if > 0.

ken-infra: I'm running cache flush now on the 12 edge nodes in us-west-2 (scripts/edge/cache_flush --filter=us-west-2 --target=gw-*)

ken-infra: cache flushed, restarting canary node to pick up new runtime flags.

sam-oncall: canary shows errors dropped to zero after cache flush + patch deployed to canary. Rolling to 50% -> 100% over next 45m.

nicole-platform: we'll also lower JWKS cache TTL globally for 24h window. Flag flipped.

maria-eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/edge-runtime/pull/312 - includes unit tests + one integration test against jwks-rotate harness. Please review quickly.

sam-oncall: great; keep INC-2026 updated. postmortem action items: add logic for immediate JWKS refetch on `kid not found`, expose cache-flush to support, instrument (metric + alert), adjust default TTL recommendation in docs.

dee-support: Customer notified and looped in account exec. Will mark as `waiting on rollback verification` until full rollout.

maria-eng: root cause summary: overly-aggressive JWKS caching (24h) + missing refetch-on-kid-missing fallback path allowed a small window where rotated KIDs caused 401s. Fix deployed and canary green. Will follow up with postmortem.

sam-oncall: thanks all. tagging owners: @maria-eng (hotfix), @ken-infra (cache ops), @nicole-platform (TTL flag + monitor), @dee-support (customer comms). :thumbsup:
